name: skills
description: BuildBetter's spec workflow and browser verification skills packaged for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven planning and browser verification skills for Codex
interface.longDescription: Bring BuildBetter Skills into Codex with spec generation, planning, review, task generation, app mapping, browser verification, and Playwright test scaffolding. This plugin packages the upstream BuildBetter Skills prompts as Codex-local skills and includes Playwright MCP wiring for the testing pack.
defaultPrompt: Turn this feature idea into a spec, plan, and tasks
Map this app and verify the UI in a browser
Generate Playwright tests from the current app flow
